第九章 以国士待我,以国士报之
在贝尔加莫的第一堂训练课，迪甘就感觉到了不同，倒不是曼多利尼的训练安排有多高端，只是他在穿越之后第一次感受到了团队训练。
在这里迪甘还交到了第一个朋友，同样出米兰的绍达蒂，大概是同样的出身，同样被抛弃的命运，让绍达蒂觉得他们两个之间应该能有很多共同语言，对于绍达蒂的主动示好，迪甘并没有拒绝，他还没有自傲到以为自己宇宙无敌的地步。
不过这份友谊来得快，去得也快，因为分组对抗训练的时候，绍达蒂突然发现，这个顶着中后卫名头被租借过来的巴西大个子，居然是来和他抢饭碗的。
绍达蒂一心想要做亚特兰大的头牌，岂能容忍比人染指他的王座，刚才还满脸堆欢的跟要卖菊花一样，现在就横眉冷对迪甘指了。
可怜的意大利人大概永远都弄不明白，即使没有迪甘，他也永远都不可能成为亚特兰大球迷的新偶像。因为和二进宫的他相比，年轻了六岁，更加鲜嫩的帕奇尼显然更加附和新偶像的标准。
迪甘也没想到第一次队内对抗赛，他会被安排在前锋的位置上，这让他对蒙多利尼的好感度直线上升，甚至生出一种士为知己者死的冲动。
塔索蒂不了解他，埃拉尼奥根本就不愿意看他，反倒是素不相识的蒙多利尼愿意给他机会，彼以国士待我，我当以国士报之。
外边虽然是个西方人的面孔，但是骨子里迪甘还是个中国人，滴水之恩，涌泉相报，儒家思想对他的影响可不是吃几块披萨就能被抹去的。
既然要报答，那么就先从那象征着主力的黄背心开始吧。
蒙多利尼坐在场边的一个高架子上面，像极了排球比赛的教练，此刻他正聚精会神的看着场上，当然注意力都集中在了迪甘的身上，虽然把迪甘签了过来，但是事后他也觉得自己有些冲动了，仅凭一个表演证明不了什么，谁也不能说迪甘那次进攻不是昙花一现。
是骡子，是马，还是要拉出来溜溜才行。
虽然只是队内对抗赛，但是球员们都知道，赛季开始之前的热身尤为重要，主教练就在一旁看着，他将根据场上球员的表现来确定新赛季一场比赛的主力阵容，而第一场比赛的先发名单，基本上也就是这个赛季的主力了。
因此人人都鼓足了干劲儿，等着充当裁判的助理教练里卡多.蒙多尼科吹响比赛开始的哨音。
穿着黄背心，像极了城管执法大队的主力一方先开球，绍达蒂和皮亚站在了中线，迪甘这边和他在锋线上搭档的则是年轻的帕奇尼。
现在的帕奇尼还显得很稚嫩，和未来那个梅开二度先生比起来，充其量就是个小嫩芽。
感觉到迪甘的目光，帕奇尼有些疑惑，他并不认识对方，不过看着迪甘在对着他笑，他也不好没有任何表示，也笑了一下。
基情就在这一刻四射了。
比赛开始，两名前锋倒脚之后，足球到了左路马尔科利尼的脚下，看看没有机会，又传给了阿尔贝蒂尼。
在目前这支亚特兰大队中，只有三个人的主力位置是稳固的，一个是门将泰比，一个是亚特兰大超级明星蒙托利沃，还有一个就是意大利之肺阿尔贝蒂尼了。

曾经有人说过，阿尔贝蒂尼要是咳嗽一声，整个意大利都要集体感冒，可见他对意大利足球的重要性，但就是这么一大块肺，如今却不得不走上了颠沛流离的道路，被热爱的AC米兰抛弃，然后辗转马德里竞技，拉齐奥，现在又到了亚特兰大。
迪甘真不知道阿尔贝蒂尼当时选择加盟的时候是怎么想的，亚特兰大这身队服，除了能让他想起国际米兰之外，还能有什么。
阿尔贝蒂尼老了，但是他的状态犹在，只是稍稍观察了一下，就一脚直传，塞给了突在前面的绍达蒂，只可惜后者面前已经站着一名防守球员了，同样曾效力过米兰的中后卫萨拉，干净利落的先出一脚，直接将球断掉，而后第一时间传给了高蒂耶里。
“这里！”
安静的球场上突然传来了一声大喊，高蒂耶里只是稍稍迟疑了一下，便循着声音将球传向了左路。
在那里奔跑着的正是迪甘，一个初来乍到的小字辈居然对有着二百多场意甲比赛经验的老前辈大呼小叫，曼多利尼见状都不禁一愣。
这小子肯定不是个能让人省心的主儿！
不过~~~~~~~~~这小子跑得可真快！
亚特兰大的球员也是第一次和迪甘合练，同样都被迪甘那速度给狠狠的震了一把，任谁都难以相信一个将近两米，体重接近一百公斤的巨人，能拥有这样的速度。
不过他们到底是职业球员，很快就反应了过来，该进攻的进攻，该防守的防守。
迪甘带着球，见注意一方的右后卫里瓦尔塔已经逼了上来，他们都是新到的菜鸟，不过这会儿迪甘可没有惺惺相惜的意思，他们都要为自己争夺位置，发扬风格，开什么玩笑，哪一个成功人士，不是踩着别人的尸体爬上去的。
曼多利尼也打起了精神，他想要看看迪甘到底会怎么做，速度迪甘已经展现出来了，接下来他又能带给自己怎样的惊喜。
高速突击之中的迪甘眼看着就要和里瓦尔塔撞在一起，突然他放慢了速度，右脚越过了足球，身体也偏向了右侧。
又是那一招吗？突然内切射门！？
曼多利尼之前看过了迪甘的比赛录像，印象最深的当然就是那次内切之后的攻门。
不过这次要是还用同一招的话，进攻手段未免单调了些吧！
单调！？
迪甘很快就给出了答案，里瓦尔塔同样以为迪甘要变相，但就在这时，迪甘的右脚没有碰到足球，紧接着左脚跟进，将球向前远远的踢出去，同时再次加速，将被骗到的里瓦尔塔甩在了身后。
曼多利尼激动的几乎要跳起来，迪甘这次变速过人的确精彩，但是更让他兴奋的是迪甘在面对里瓦尔塔的时候，居然一点儿都不怯场。
开什么玩笑！

虽然两世为人，迪甘从来都没真正踢过职业足球，但是怎么说也是进过国字号的人物，经历过大场面的，而且迪甘天生就有一颗大心脏，粗神经，怯场那玩意儿，他可没感觉到过，而且越是比赛的时候，对手越是强大，他就越兴奋。
里瓦尔塔被迪甘突破，另一名后卫贡内拉再想补位已经来不及了，等到他冲到迪甘面前的时候，迪甘已经摆出了传中的姿势。
可就在这个时候，迪甘又改主意了，抡起的左腿慢慢放下，轻轻的在足球底部一挑，紧跟着右脚发力蹬地急转向，足球从贡内拉头顶越过，刚好被迪甘接到。
这么一次漂亮的过人再次让曼多利尼的心脏一阵跳动，赚翻了，真的赚翻了！
AC米兰人！你们就等着后悔吧！
过了贡内拉的迪甘表演还在继续，这个时候他已经出现在了大禁区线上，主力一方的防守球员顿时乱了阵脚，纳塔利急着朝他扑了过来。
就在所有人都以为迪甘要继续突破的时候，只见他右脚脚弓轻轻将球一推。
早就守候在门前的帕奇尼只需要碰一下，足球就钻进了网里，完全被迪甘精彩表演吸引了的泰比甚至都没来得及作出防守动作，只能扭着身子，眼看着帕奇尼射门得分。
进球之后帕奇尼显得很兴奋，直接朝迪甘扑了过来，虽然只是队内的教学比赛，可只要有了出色的表现，至少能让他在曼多利尼的心里赚取更多的影响分，等到新赛季开始之后，他才能获得更多的机会。
迪甘笑着和帕奇尼抱了一下，接着转头看向了场边的曼多利尼，举起了右臂用力的挥了下拳头。
老头！选择我，你是不会后悔的！

Chapter 9: Treat me as a countryman and repay me as a countryman.
Deegan felt the difference in the first training session in Bergamo. It wasn't that Mandolini's training arrangements were high-end, but it was just the first time he felt team training after traveling through time.
Here Deegan also made his first friend, Saudati, who also came from Milan. Probably from the same background and the same fate of being abandoned, Saudati felt that there should be a lot in common between the two of them. Degan did not refuse Saudati's overtures. He was not so arrogant as to think that he was invincible in the universe.
However, this friendship came and went quickly, because during group confrontation training, Saudati suddenly discovered that the Brazilian big man who was loaned out as a central defender was actually here to compete with him for his job.
Saudati wanted to be Atlanta's number one, how could he tolerate someone else interfering with his throne? Just a moment ago, he was as happy as if he wanted to sell chrysanthemums, but now he is pointing cold fingers at Deegan.
The poor Italian will probably never understand that even without Deegan, he will never become the new idol of Atlanta fans. Because compared with him when he entered the palace for the second time, Paccini is six years younger and more fresh, and it is obvious that he is more in line with the standards of the new idol.
Deegan also didn't expect that he would be placed in the forward position in the first intra-team match, which made his favorability towards Mondolini soar, and he even had the urge to die for his confidant.
Tassotti didn't understand him, and Eranio didn't want to look at him at all. On the contrary, Mondolini, who had never met him before, was willing to give him a chance. He treated me as a countryman, and I should repay him as a countryman.
Although he looks like a Westerner on the outside, Deegan is still Chinese in his heart. Every drop of kindness is repaid by a spring. The influence of Confucianism on him cannot be erased by eating a few pieces of pizza.
Since we want to repay, let’s start with the yellow vests that symbolize the main force.
Mondolini was sitting on a high shelf on the sidelines, like a coach in a volleyball match. At this moment, he was watching the court attentively. Of course, his attention was focused on Deegan. Although he signed Deegan, he felt that he was a little impulsive afterwards. Just one performance could not prove anything. No one could say that Deegan's attack was not a flash in the pan.
Whether it's a mule or a horse, it still needs to be pulled out for a ride.
Although it is only an intra-team match, the players all know that the warm-up before the start of the season is particularly important. The head coach is watching from the sidelines. He will determine the main lineup for a game in the new season based on the performance of the players on the field. The starting lineup for the first game is basically the main lineup for this season.
Therefore, everyone worked hard and waited for the assistant coach Ricardo Mondonico, who acted as the referee, to blow the whistle to start the game.
Wearing yellow vests, the main team that looked like the urban management and law enforcement team kicked off first. Saudati and Pia stood in the middle line. Degan's partner on the front line was the young Pacini.
The current Pacini still looks very immature. Compared with the future Mr. Scorer, he is just a bud at best.
Feeling Deegan's gaze, Pachini was a little confused. He didn't know the other party, but when he saw Deegan smiling at him, he didn't say anything and smiled.
The passion spread at this moment.
At the beginning of the game, after the two forwards stepped back, the football came to the feet of Marcolini on the left. Seeing that there was no chance, he passed the ball to Albertini.
In the current Atlanta team, only three people's main positions are stable, one is goalkeeper Taibbi, one is Atlanta superstar Montolivo, and the other is Italian lung Albertini.
Someone once said that if Albertini coughed, the whole of Italy would catch a cold. This shows his importance to Italian football.But just such a big lung, now he has to embark on a wandering road, being abandoned by his beloved AC Milan, and then moved to Atletico Madrid, Lazio, and now Atlanta.
Deegan really didn't know what Albertini was thinking when he chose to join. In addition to reminding him of Inter Milan, Atlanta's uniform could do anything else.
Albertini is old, but his condition is still there. After just observing for a moment, he passed the ball directly to Saudati, who was standing in front of him. Unfortunately, there was already a defender standing in front of the latter. Center back Sala, who also played for Milan, took a clean first kick, intercepted the ball directly, and then passed it to Gautieri immediately.
"Here!"
There was a sudden shout on the quiet court, and Gautieri just hesitated for a moment, then followed the sound and passed the ball to the left.
It was Deegan who was running there. A junior who had just arrived actually yelled at a senior who had more than 200 Serie A games experience. Mandolini couldn't help but be surprised when he saw this.
This guy is definitely not someone who can make people worry-free!
But~~~~~~~~~This kid can run really fast!
It was also the first time for Atlanta's players to train with Deegan, and they were all shocked by Deegan's speed. It was hard for anyone to believe that a giant nearly two meters tall and weighing nearly a hundred kilograms could possess such speed.
But they are professional players after all, and they quickly reacted, attacking when they should attack, and defending when they should.
Deegan carried the ball and noticed that Rivalta, the right back of the other side, had already pressed forward. They were all newbies, but Deegan had no intention of showing sympathy to each other at this moment. They all wanted to compete for their own position and promote their style. What a joke. No successful person climbed up by stepping on other people's corpses.
Mandolini also cheered up. He wanted to see what Deegan would do. Deegan had already shown his speed, and what surprises he could bring to him next.
During the high-speed assault, Deegan was about to collide with Rivalta. Suddenly he slowed down, crossed the football with his right foot, and turned his body to the right.
Is it that trick again? Suddenly cut inside and shot! ?
Mandolini had watched Deegan's game video before, and what impressed him most was of course the attack after the inside cut.
But if the same trick is used this time, the offensive method will be a bit monotonous!
monotonous! ?
Deegan quickly gave the answer. Rivalta also thought that Deegan was going to disguise himself, but at this moment, Deegan's right foot did not touch the football. He followed up with his left foot and kicked the ball far forward. At the same time, he accelerated again, leaving the deceived Rivalta behind.
Mandolini was so excited that he almost jumped up. Deegan's speed change was indeed wonderful, but what made him even more excited was that Deegan didn't have any stage fright when facing Rivalta.
What a joke!
Although he has never really played professional football in his two lives, Deegan has been a national figure and experienced big scenes. Moreover, Deegan is born with a big heart, thick nerves, and stage fright. He has never felt it. Moreover, the more powerful the opponent is during the game, the more excited he becomes.
Rivalta was broken through by Deegan, and it was too late for the other defender Gonnella to make up the position. By the time he rushed in front of Deegan, Deegan had already posed for a cross.
But at this moment, Deegan changed his mind again. He slowly lowered his swung left leg, gently picked it up at the bottom of the football, then pushed hard with his right foot and turned sharply. The football passed over Gonella's head and was just caught by Deegan.
Such a beautiful pass made Mandolini's heart beat again. He made a lot of money, really made a lot of money!
AC Milan people! youJust wait to regret it!
Deegan's performance after passing Gonnella continued. At this time, he had appeared on the line of the penalty area. The defensive players of the main team were suddenly confused, and Natalie rushed towards him eagerly.
Just when everyone thought Deegan was going to continue to break through, they saw him gently push the ball with the arch of his right foot.
Pacini, who had been waiting in front of the goal for a long time, only needed to touch it, and the football went into the net. Taibbi, who was completely attracted by Deegan's wonderful performance, did not even have time to make a defensive move. He could only twist his body and watch Pacini score.
After scoring the goal, Pacini seemed very excited and rushed directly towards Deegan. Although it was just a teaching game within the team, as long as he had an outstanding performance, he could at least earn more influence points in Mandolini's heart. Only after the start of the new season can he get more opportunities.
Deegan smiled and hugged Pacini, then turned to look at Mandolini on the sidelines, raised his right arm and shook his fist vigorously.
Old man! Choose me, you won't regret it!
